prompt: some people spend most of their time lives living close to where they born.what are the reasons and explain advantage and disadvantage
essay:
Living in the same area where they were born is one of the choices that the population decide to spend most of their time. In this essay, I will explain a few factors behind their decision, and describe what are the advantages and disadvantages of staying locally.

The reasons vary among the society. First and foremost, they choose to live in their hometown because they can stay close to their families and friends. As they are in the same town, they usually live together with their family. For example, many of them, especially in Asian culture, still live under the same roof with their parents as long as they are not married yet. As they have known each other for a long time, it creates strong bonds between them. Furthermore, some people do not go abroad as they  already have a stable job or a permanent home in their city. Therefore, they do not have the urgency to move.

On the one hand, staying locally brings several advantages, such as increasing quality time and reducing stress. For instance, there is a family of three consisting of a father, a mother and one kid, where they can improve their relations by going on vacation every weekend. This is possible as they live together in the same town. Moreover, people who choose to stay where they are already familiar with the area do not need to adapt to the new environment, which can minimise their stress level. This is because they really know their surroundings, like schools, hospitals, public facilities or even restaurants. For example, they truly understand where  the best restaurant serving delicious food and with that, they are not stressed to pick food for lunch.

On the other hand, choosing their hometown leads to disadvantages. Especially in little towns or rural areas, they may face limited career opportunities. Because it is only a small city, job opportunities may be accessible for a few fields, like government institutions, schools, or hospitals. As a result, they are on limit to choose what kind of work they want. Furthermore, not only  that, but it may also decrease the exposure to different cultures that will broaden their knowledge.

In conclusion, some people choose to stay in their hometown due to family matters and sufficient life. If they can stay close with their relatives, have proper work, and have already built a good house, they do not find any reason to leave. Moreover, staying there can give them a lot of advantages, such as having a good time with their loved ones or a comfort zone to live in, although it can limit their career opportunities and lessen their perspective.
